additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431757-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002652]Logs check CRM:02681000350
additional_info.body:
Hello,
After reviewing the session logs, it appears that the issue was caused by a contactor that opened unexpectedly. This was likely due to a current spike that triggered the protection mechanism on the AC side, or possibly due to a lower-than-usual 24 VDC supply voltage.
Does this issue occur frequently? If so, could you please send me the timestamps of the other occurrences?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen / Best regards,
Francois WINCKEL

o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
